variables.name: Core/Interaction/Hover
variables.description: Use as the background fill for hover feedback on neutral interactive surfaces. Do not use for selected, focus, disabled, or system feedback states.

variables.name: Core/Interaction/Selected
variables.description: Use as the background fill for selected items or active choices. Do not use for error, success, warning, or disabled states.

variables.name: Core/Overlay/Scrim
variables.description: Use behind modal, dialog, drawer, or sheet surfaces to reduce emphasis on underlying content. Do not use as a content surface.

variables.description: Static dark content for light or sufficiently bright colored surfaces such as YAK yellow. Does not invert between Light and Dark modes.
